content: The number 9.9 is larger than 9.11. To compare these two numbers, you look at the digits from left to right. The first digit (9) is the same in both numbers, but the second digit (after the decimal point) is different. In 9.9, the second digit is 9, while in 9.11, the second digit is 1. Since 9 is greater than 1, 9.9 is the larger number.
